losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Before the accident, the plaintiff enjoyed basketball, swimming, cycling, jogging and other such activities. He is now unable to take part in these.
He was and still is unable to return to work as a plumber.
He is called unkind names, such as 'Crippled Cheung' which embarrasses and upsets him.
